title: Section restriction preserves a coefficient comparison square
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $v:B'\to B$, $p:P\to B$, $q:P'\to B'$, $h:P'\to P$, $z:B\to P$, and $w:B'\to P'$ be morphisms of schemes with $hp=qv$, $wh=vz$, $zp=1_B$, and $wq=1_{B'}$. In the ordinary etale derived categories write $P_f=Lf^*$, $\gamma_{a,b}:P_{ab}\simeq P_bP_a$ for the canonical compositor and $\sigma_z:P_zP_p\simeq1$ and $\sigma_w:P_wP_q\simeq1$ for the section compositors [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $K\in D(B,A)$, $K'\in D(B',A)$, $L\in D(P,A)$ and $L'\in D(P',A)$, and take maps $e:P_vK\to K'$, $a:P_pK\to L$, $a':P_qK'\to L'$, and $b:P_hL\to L'$. Here $\gamma_{q,v}^{hp}$ denotes the compositor with common composite $hp$. The cached inverse images and constant-coefficient conventions are [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. Let $T:P_vP_z\simeq P_wP_h$ be $\gamma_{v,z}^{-1}\gamma_{w,h}$ with common composite $vz$, using $wh=vz$. If $P_h(a)b=\gamma_{h,p}^{-1}\gamma_{q,v}^{hp}P_q(e)a'$, then
$$P_v(\sigma_z^{-1}P_z(a))\,T_L\,P_w(b)=e\,\sigma_w^{-1}\,P_w(a').$$
Composition is displayed in the order maps are applied. Neither Cartesianity nor invertibility of $a$, $a'$, $b$, or $e$ is required.

proof.text: Expand the section pullback square as the inverse compositor for v,z followed by the compositor for w,h with common composite v z. Naturality of these two compositors moves a to its pullback along h. Replace h* a followed by b with the assumed coefficient square. The section-compositor pasting identity identifies the remaining middle path with the inverse target section compositor: compose the identity leftDerivedUpperStar_map_comp_compSectionIso with the inverse source section compositor and the inverse section square, using the source-library common-composite congruence to change w h to v z. Finally naturality of the target section compositor moves e to the front. This is formal functoriality and inverse cancellation; no finiteness, Cartesianity or nonzero coefficient is used.

theorem sectionPullback_coefficient_naturality
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {B B' P P' : Scheme.{u}} (v : B' ⟶ B) (p : P ⟶ B) (q : P' ⟶ B')
    (h : P' ⟶ P) (z : B ⟶ P) (w : B' ⟶ P')
    (hp : h ≫ p = q ≫ v) (hz : w ≫ h = v ≫ z)
    (h₀ : z ≫ p = 𝟙 B) (h₁ : w ≫ q = 𝟙 B')
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A B) (K' : DerivedCategoryModule A B')
    (L : DerivedCategoryModule A P) (L' : DerivedCategoryModule A P')
    (e : (ordinaryFinitePullback A v).obj K ⟶ K')
    (a : (ordinaryFinitePullback A p).obj K ⟶ L)
    (a' : (ordinaryFinitePullback A q).obj K' ⟶ L')
    (b : (ordinaryFinitePullback A h).obj L ⟶ L')
    (ha : (ordinaryFinitePullback A h).map a ≫ b =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h p).inv.app K ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q v (h ≫ p) hp).hom.app K ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A q).map e ≫ a') :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A v).map
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) z p h₀).inv.app K ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePullback A z).map a) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v z).inv.app L ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w h (v ≫ z) hz.symm).hom.app L ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePullback A w).map b =
    e ≫ (leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w q h₁).inv.app K' ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A w).map a'
